# Beomyong Choi (최범용)

> AEO Engineer & Full-stack Developer. A backend engineer who moved into Answer
> Engine Optimization (AEO) — measuring and improving how brands surface inside
> AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity. Builds the
> measurement platforms and content infrastructure behind that work.

This site is a portfolio, engineering blog, and resume in one place. It is being
rebuilt; sections below will fill in over time.

## Focus areas
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- LLM-based measurement pipelines (query generation → search → multi-model analysis)
- Full-stack product engineering (Next.js, Fastify, Prisma) and cloud infra (GCP)
- Backend engineering foundations
